home.title: Welcome
home.welcomeDefault: Welcome to the residents' page of our community.

register.title: Registration application
register.intro: Fill in the form. An administrator checks it, then you activate your account in the Telegram bot.
register.consent: I agree that my data is stored to check that I live here
register.unavailable: Registration is not open yet. Please try again later.
register.doneText: After an administrator approves it, open the bot and share your phone number. Then you can log in.
register.qrHint: Scan with your phone if you are on a computer
register.linkExpired: This link has expired or was already used. Get a new one in the bot, or fill in the form yourself.

login.title: Log in
login.codeSent: If this number has access, a code was sent to your Telegram. Enter it below.
login.linkExpired: This login link has expired or was already used.
login.linkHint: Send /cabinet to the bot for a new link, or log in with your phone number below.
login.linkOtherUser: You are signed in as {{name}}. Sign in with this link instead, as the account it belongs to?

applications.title: Applications
applications.hint: Open a person to correct the details before approving.
applications.emptyHint: New applications appear here. Share the registration link in the community chat.

user.phoneLocked: Unlink Telegram to change the phone of an activated user.
user.disableConfirm: Disable {{name}}? They will be logged out and cannot log in until enabled.
user.firstAdminLocked: The first administrator cannot be disabled, lose admin rights or be unlinked from a messenger.
user.noChannels: No messenger is linked yet. The person activates the account by sharing their phone in the bot.
user.unlinkHint: The user goes back to awaiting activation and must share the phone in the bot again.
user.notResidentHint: The Resident flag is off: these apartments are kept but ignored.

botLink.title: Waiting for activation in the bot
botLink.hint: Send the person this link: they open the bot and share their phone number.

agents.title: Connected agents
agents.revokeConfirm: Disconnect {{client}}? It loses access at once; connecting again needs a new approval.

connect.title: Connect an AI agent
connect.turnOnFirst: Turn on MCP in Roles (on the left) first; without it the agent cannot be approved.
connect.step1: In Claude open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector and paste the address above.
connect.step2: Claude opens a Homelander page: log in with the code from Telegram.
connect.step3: Check that the answer goes to claude.ai or claude.com, then press Allow.
connect.chatgpt1: Open chatgpt.com/plugins, press + → Add custom MCP server, and paste the address above. Custom MCP servers are not available on every plan; in Business, Enterprise and Edu a workspace admin may have to allow them first.
connect.chatgpt2: ChatGPT opens a Homelander page: log in with the code from Telegram.
connect.chatgpt3: Check that the answer goes to chatgpt.com, then press Allow.

user.labelsHint: Messages sent to these labels come to this person in the bot.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.viaBotLink: with a link from the bot

houses.title: Houses
houses.emptyHint: Add the community houses: registration does not open without them.

house.name: Name
house.nameHint: As residents know it, e.g. "12" or "7, section 1"
house.archivedHint: An archived house is hidden from registration.

statuses.title: Residency statuses
statuses.codeHint: Latin letters, digits and _; cannot be changed later
statuses.name: Name

site.title: Site
site.description: The pages residents see and the built-in home page.
site.liveEmpty: Nothing published — residents see the built-in page
site.liveEmptyHint: Ask your AI agent to build a site or upload a zip, then preview and publish the draft.
site.draftsEmpty: No drafts. Ask your AI agent or upload a zip
site.restoreConfirm: Publish version #{{id}} again? It replaces what is live now.
site.cardsHint: Public data items become cards on the built-in page, in this order.
site.cardTitleHint: Empty: a title from the key
site.noPublic: No public data yet: make the items you need public in the Data section.
site.noCards: No cards — nothing is shown under the quarter.
site.previewHint: How the page looks while nothing is published. Changes show before you save.
site.notPublic: Not public — the card is hidden

invite.title: Invite residents
invite.hint: Pin this link in the community chat or print the QR code. Residents apply with it; you approve each application.
invite.downloadFailed: Could not save the QR code. Try another browser or take a screenshot.

overview.title: Overview
overview.hint: What matters today: new applications and the registration link.

setup.title: Set up your community
setup.hint: Registration opens once there is at least one house and one residency status.

chats.title: Chats
chats.description: Groups, forums and topics the bot is in. Hang labels on them to say what goes where.
chats.newHint: The bot is in this chat, but nobody has confirmed it yet. Accept it so it can receive messages, or make the bot leave.
chats.leaveSoon: Added by someone who is not an administrator: the bot will leave at {{time}} unless you accept the chat.
chats.leaveConfirm: The bot will leave “{{title}}”. To bring it back, add it to the group again.
chats.cannotSend: The bot cannot send messages here. Check its rights in the group.
chats.emptyTitle: The bot is not in any chat yet
chats.emptyText: A chat appears here when an administrator adds the bot to it, or when someone writes in a chat the bot is already in.
chats.leftWarning: The bot is not in this chat: it receives nothing, whatever labels it has. Add the bot again to bring it back.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: A label names a place to write to. Modules and notices write to a label; you decide which chats carry it.
labels.name: Name

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Where the system posts its own notices. Pick a label; every chat carrying it gets the notice.
notifications.applicationsHint: A short notice about each new application, without the phone number.
notifications.noChat: This label does not reach an accepted chat or a person with the bot yet, so the notices will go nowhere.

data.title: Data
data.description: Values and tables the site shows and modules use. Each item says who sees it: everyone, residents or only admins.
data.keyHint: Lower-case Latin letters, digits, _ and dots: house.address. Cannot be changed later.
data.descriptionHint: What this data is. Admins and the AI agent see it.
data.visibilityHint: Everyone: guests too. Residents: logged-in residents and admins. Admins: only admins, here and through the AI agent; never on the site. Pages published on the site can show residents-level data to logged-in residents.
data.removeColumnConfirm: Remove column “{{name}}”? Once columns are saved, its values in every row are deleted.
data.deleteItemConfirm: Delete “{{key}}” with all its rows? The site and modules that read it will no longer see it.
data.ownedAlert: Managed by module "{{name}}": only who can see it can be changed here.
data.ownedOffAlert: The module is off, so this data reaches neither the site nor residents now.

pages.title: Site page
pages.description: Your own home page: upload a version, preview it and publish it. With nothing published, the built-in page is shown.
pages.uploadHint: index.html, other pages (contacts.html → /contacts) and their files (CSS, JS, images), up to 20 MB
pages.unpublishConfirm: The home page will show the built-in page again. The published version goes to the archive.
pages.publishConfirm: Publish version #{{id}}? All visitors will see it right away.
pages.deleteConfirm: Delete version #{{id}}? This cannot be undone.
pages.previewHint: This is how visitors will see the page

fileError.type: {{path}}: this file type is not supported. Allowed: HTML, CSS, JS, JSON, SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, WOFF2 (lower-case extensions).
fileError.invalid: {{path}}: file name not allowed (Latin letters, digits, . _ - only; no preview/ folder).
fileError.reserved_page_name: {{path}}: this page name is taken by an app address (admin, login, api, …). Rename the file.
fileError.invalid_page_name: {{path}}: a page name may use only lower-case Latin letters, digits and hyphens (e.g. contacts.html).

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Built-in features you can turn on or off for the whole community.

moduleOff.title: The module is turned off
moduleOff.text: While the module is off, residents don't see its section in the cabinet and its data doesn't reach the site. Everything saved stays: turn the module on and it is back.

feed.title: News feed
feed.description: Announcements for residents in the cabinet and, if you like, in Telegram chats.
feed.emptyHint: Write the first announcement: residents see it in the cabinet, and chats with the chosen labels get a copy.

settings.defaultLabelsHint: They fill "Also post to" of every new post. Only labels on accepted chats are listed.
settings.noLabels: No label is on an accepted chat yet, so posts go to the cabinet only.

editor.bodyHint: Plain text; links become clickable in the cabinet.
editor.tooLongWithImage: With an image the text must be at most {{max}} characters (Telegram's caption limit).
editor.tooLong: The text must be at most {{max}} characters.
editor.labelsHint: Chats and topics with these labels get one copy each. Empty means the cabinet only.
editor.previewEmpty: Start writing and the post appears here.
editor.publishConfirm: Publish the post? Residents see it in the cabinet, and chats with the labels "{{labels}}" get a copy. Once sent, a copy can't be recalled or changed.
editor.publishConfirmCabinetOnly: Publish the post? Residents see it in the cabinet. Nothing goes to Telegram.
editor.publishedNote: Edits change the cabinet and the site only: copies already sent to Telegram are not changed.
editor.deleteConfirm: Delete the post? It disappears from the cabinet and the site.
editor.deleteConfirmPublished: Delete the post? It disappears from the cabinet and the site. Copies already sent to Telegram stay.
editor.author: By {{name}}

deliveries.title: Delivery to Telegram
deliveries.expired: Delivery details are no longer kept.
deliveries.cabinetOnly: The post was published to the cabinet only.

errors.bad_request: The request could not be understood. Reload the page and try again.
errors.conflict: This action is not possible in the current state.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this.
errors.last_admin: This is the last active administrator: they cannot lose admin rights or be disabled.
errors.first_admin: This is the first administrator: they cannot be disabled, lose admin rights or be unlinked from a messenger.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.try_later: Too many applications are waiting right now. Please try again later.
errors.invalid_code: The code is wrong or has expired.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.chat_not_accepted: Nobody here can receive messages yet: accept the chat, or check the person has the bot linked.
errors.token_invalid: This link has expired or was already used.
errors.module_owned: A module manages this data: only who can see it can be changed.
errors.link_other_user: You are signed in to another account.

validation.linked: Unlink the messenger first to change the phone
validation.has_residents: Residents are registered in apartments outside this range
validation.type: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP images
validation.size: The file is larger than 5 MB
validation.type_change_not_empty: A column type can be changed only in an empty table
validation.key_reserved: Keys with this prefix belong to a module
validation.published: A published post can't be sent anywhere else

chat.auto_left: Bot left a chat added by a stranger

oauth.title: Connect an AI agent
oauth.question: Allow {{client}} to act as you in Homelander?
oauth.redirectHost: The answer goes to {{host}}. Allow only if you started this connection yourself.
oauth.explain: The agent will be able to read and change site data and write page drafts on your behalf. It cannot publish pages. Every action is recorded in the audit log as yours, via MCP.
oauth.loginFirst: {{client}} asks to act as you in Homelander. Log in first.
oauth.invalid: This connection request is not valid. Start the connection again from the agent.

reason.not_admin: Only an admin can connect an AI agent.
reason.mcp_off: MCP is off for your account. Another admin (or you) can turn it on on your user card in the admin panel.

home.subtitle: Your home in the community, in one place.

myHome.title: My home
myHome.empty: No apartment is linked to your account yet.
myHome.emptyHint: If you live in the community, ask an administrator to add your apartment.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.hint: To change these details, ask an administrator.

install.title: Install the app
install.text: Add the cabinet to your home screen: it opens in one tap, like any other app.
install.iosText: Tap Share at the bottom of the screen, then “Add to Home Screen”.

feed.name: News feed
feed.description: Admins' announcements in the residents' cabinet. Each post can also go to Telegram chats by label, and the site can show the latest posts.
